statement: ∀ (x y : ℝ), cbrt (x ^ 3) = x ∧ cbrt y ^ 3 = y
script:
# name: set-cbrt-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Inverse.cbrt_inverse
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['0', '0'], True, 'have key : ∀ (x y : ℝ), cbrt (x ^ 3) = x ∧ cbrt y ^ 3 = y := by
  intro x y
  have h3 : ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  have key : ∀ y : ℝ, cbrt y ^ 3 = y := by
    intro y
    unfold cbrt
    split_ifs with hy
    · rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hy, inv_mul_cancel₀ h3, Real.rpow_one]
    · rw [neg_pow, ← Real.rpow_natCast ((-y) ^ _), ← Real.rpow_mul (by linarith), inv_mul_cancel₀ h3,
        Real.rpow_one]
      norm_num
  refine ⟨?_, key y⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3) := (Odd.strictMono_pow (by decide : Odd 3)).injective
  exact hinj (key (x ^ 3))
exact @key (0) (0)'),
    (['2', '8'], False, 'have key : ∀ (x y : ℝ), cbrt (x ^ 3) = x ∧ cbrt y ^ 3 = y := by
  intro x y
  have h3 : ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by norm_num

        Real.rpow_one]
      norm_num
  refine ⟨?_, key y⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3) := (Odd.strictMono_pow (by decide : Odd 3)).injective
  exact hinj (key (x ^ 3))
exact @key (2) (8)'),
    (['-2', '-27'], False, 'have key : ∀ (x y : ℝ), cbrt (x ^ 3) = x ∧ cbrt y ^ 3 = y := by
  intro x y
  have h3 : ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  have key : ∀ y : ℝ, cbrt y ^ 3 = y := by
    intro y
    unfold cbrt

        Real.rpow_one]
      norm_num
  refine ⟨?_, key y⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3) := (Odd.strictMono_pow (by decide : Odd 3)).injective
  exact hinj (key (x ^ 3))
exact @key (-2) (-27)'),
]
instances = [kernel_instance(*values, proof=proof, edge=edge) for values, edge, proof in CASES]
